fato_historico: 610: Heraclius arrives at Constantinople, kills Byzantine Emperor Phocas, and becomes emperor.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos suggests that shifting power dynamics may create a new path for your personal growth. Just as a new leader arrives to restore order to a chaotic empire, you may find that it is a good time to reclaim authority over your daily routine. Consider decluttering your space to invite fresh, supportive energy into your home.
frase_do_dia: True power starts with the discipline you apply to your own soul today.
significado_numero: Represents the completion of a cycle and the start of perfection.
conselho: Organize your surroundings to clear your mind and manifest your deepest desires.
